svg.title: SmartCane — 1ST PLACE / ALAMEDA COUNTY SCIENCE FAIR
svg.desc: A ~$70 cane that senses obstacles, catches falls and pages a caregiver. 97.75% distance accuracy in bench trials. 27 of 27 simulated falls detected, zero false positives in 18. Built with ARDUINO, ANDROID, BLE, COSITE 2025 PAPER, PROVISIONAL PATENT.
